animations.name: marquee
animations.description: Continuous horizontal scroll animation for logo marquee strips, 48s duration, linear timing, infinite loop.

animations.name: menuOpen
animations.css: @keyframes menuOpen { from { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 0, 0 0); } to { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } }
animations.description: Mobile menu reveal animation using clip-path to wipe down from top, 400ms ease-in-out.

animations.name: menuClose
animations.css: @keyframes menuClose { from { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } to { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 0, 0 0); } }
animations.description: Mobile menu close animation, reverses the menuOpen clip-path wipe, 400ms ease-in-out.

animations.name: fadein
animations.description: Simple fade-in animation for modal dialogs, 400ms ease-out.

animations.name: word-animation
animations.description: Staggered word reveal animation for hero headlines. Each word translates up from 24px with fade-in using exponential ease-out curve.

animations.name: rotating-text
animations.description: Word rotation animation for cycling through text options with vertical slide and fade transitions.

animations.name: dropdown-reveal
animations.description: Navigation dropdown fade-in with custom ease curve for smooth reveal of menu content.

animations.name: button-hover
animations.description: Standard button hover transition for color properties, 200ms ease timing.

animations.name: link-hover
animations.description: Global link color transition on hover, 200ms ease.

animations.name: image-scale-hover
animations.description: Card image zoom effect on hover, scales to 1.05 with 200ms ease transition.

animations.name: consent-dialog-reveal
animations.description: Cookie consent dialog entrance animation, fades in and translates up from 16px offset.

animations.name: fable-sky-canvas-fade
animations.description: WebGL canvas fade-in for the Fable hero sky background effect.

animations.name: fable-manatee-video-fade
animations.description: Video background fade-out to reveal underlying sky canvas animation.

animations.name: spin
animations.css: @keyframes spin { 0% { transform: rotate(0); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
animations.description: Loading spinner rotation animation, continuous 360deg loop.

animations.name: slider-opacity
animations.description: Slider inactive slide fade effect, non-active slides show at 0.3 opacity.

animations.name: hamburger-line-animation
animations.description: JS-driven hamburger menu icon animation. Lines translate and rotate to form X on open state.

insights: The design system employs a sophisticated warm neutral palette (ivory/cream backgrounds, ink black text) that creates an academic, editorial aesthetic while maintaining excellent contrast ratios.

Animation design follows a consistent exponential ease-out curve (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for entrance animations, creating a snappy but elegant motion language that respects reduced-motion preferences.

Button hierarchy is established through color rather than size variations: accent coral for primary CTAs, solid dark for standard actions, and transparent/outlined for tertiary options, maintaining visual consistency across contexts.
